content.title: NSK 6203-ZZ Deep Groove Ball Bearing, Metal Shielded (ZZ), 17mm Bore x 40mm OD x 12mm Width
content.short_description: NSK 6203-ZZ deep groove ball bearing with metal shields (ZZ seal type). Bore 17 mm, OD 40 mm, width 12 mm.
content.long_description:
The NSK 6203-ZZ is a single-row deep groove ball bearing fitted with metal shields (ZZ designation) on both sides. The shields are designed to retain lubricant within the bearing cavity and provide a barrier against dust and larger particulate contamination during operation.

Dimensionally, the 6203-ZZ has a bore diameter of 17 mm, an outer diameter of 40 mm, and a width of 12 mm, corresponding to standard 6203-series envelope dimensions. This sizing allows for direct replacement in applications specifying the 6203 bearing series.

As a deep groove ball bearing, this part is suited for applications requiring support of radial loads along with limited axial loads in both directions. The ZZ metal shield configuration is a non-contact seal type, resulting in lower friction compared to contact rubber seals, at the tradeoff of reduced protection against fine or liquid contaminants.

Confirm shaft and housing fit tolerances against the stated 17 mm bore and 40 mm OD prior to installation, and verify the 12 mm width against available axial space in the mounting arrangement.
bullets: Bearing type: Single-row deep groove ball bearing
Seal type: ZZ - metal shielded, both sides
Standard 6203-series envelope dimensions for direct replacement
